title: Route_42
lead_summary:
Route 42 is a route that connects Ecruteak City to Mahogany Town. Mt. Mortar can be accessed from either side.
The player needs both Surf and Cut (or their HM Replacement Item) to traverse it.

items.name: Hard Stone
items.location_details: Given by Hiker Benjamin after defeating him.
